name: Brother Anton
objectiveText: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace .

comments.body: You need to complete this quest chain to be able to get 'In the Name of the Light' https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1053.
replies: For people who playing WoW Classic in 2019: if you can't obtain this quest, then you already pick up the next quest Down the Scarlet Path in Desolance. Check you're questlog. I'm losing almost 30min just running\flying.

comments.body: When you enter the cathedral, run to the farthest corner on your right.  There's an open door, go through it down a stone ramp, and voila- Brother Crowley's down there.

Desolace can be reached via a path in the SW corner of Stonetalon Mountains. Once you enter the northern bit of Desolace, follow the feet of the mountains to the east, there's a very obvious (lighted, with guards) path up the hill to Nigel's Point.
This quest was not available until I turned 34.
replies: Hmm, I'm positive I ran through the Cathedral to train when I hit 34, and I didn't see a questgiver when I did.  Maybe I just wasn't looking over in the corner.  I'm still 34, so I'll check on my next trip in.
You wouldn't see this guy by just running through the main hall of the cathedral -- he's kind of downstairs, down a spiral ramp in the back right.  Really out-of-the-way.

replies: The first time I went, I did a /who c-"Warlock" z-"Desolace" and had them summon me for a small price... (was on lock bloodrobe quest), but i forgot to get the flight path in nij'el so the next time i had to walk down from astraanar. So just fly to astranaar, walk down through stonetalon (go up to the NE coner to get the flight path there if you want for later) and then just walk south west from there. There's a road that goes south, usually a few 30's horde killing stuff, so be on the lookout if you are on PVP server.
